verses.english: “There are these two kinds of sharing.
Sharing things of the flesh and sharing the teaching.
These are the two kinds of sharing.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ saṁvibhāgānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammasaṁvibhāgo”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of sharing is sharing the teaching.”
